ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "DISRUPTING DIXIE: MUSIC AND THE AMERICAN SOUTH." What images come to mind when you think of the "American South?" What sounds are in your mind's ear? Do you hear banjos and Dolly Parton or Lil Nas X and gospel hymns? This course interrogates the American South as knowledge by critiquing long-held assumptions of place and complicating frequently essentialized notions of southern culture. Although we'll discuss southern-based musical genres and forms such as country, spirituals, blues, and bluegrass, we will reorient narratives of place by addressing integral aspects of race, class, gender and sexual identities. This course is open to a wide range of students, whether interested in popular or art musics, and asks them to think critically about their own assumptions based on place.
